item.name: Club of Zagod

ownerLore.text: Zagod was a disgraced dwarven inquisitor who lived between 392 - ???.

item.description: Zagod was a disgraced dwarven inquisitor who lived between 392 - ???. The club was recovered from a battlefield long after the dead had been forgotten.

item.name: Splint Mail of Ralhog

ownerLore.text: Ralhog was a disreputable dwarven stonecutter who lived between 316 - 396.

item.description: Ralhog was a disreputable dwarven stonecutter who lived between 316 - 396. An ancient splint mail, its surface worn smooth by generations of hands that are long gone. It is said the owner never let this splint mail out of his sight, not even in death.

item.name: Doublet of Borlon

ownerLore.text: Borlon was a disgraced dwarven explorer who lived between 516 - ???.

item.description: Borlon was a disgraced dwarven explorer who lived between 516 - ???. Dust never seems to settle on this doublet, no matter how long it sits untouched. Doublet of Borlon did not rest easy, and neither, it seems, does what he left behind.

item.name: Club of Morus

ownerLore.text: Morus was a shady dwarven weaponsmith who lived between 152 - 252.

item.description: Morus was a shady dwarven weaponsmith who lived between 152 - 252. The club was recovered from a grave that had been opened from the inside. Every page, every rune, seems to cost something to understand. Something about it draws on your own vitality just to remain whole.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Identification

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Homecoming
merchantStock.description: A magical passage back to the Temple, far from the dangers of the wilderness.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Invisibility
merchantStock.description: A scroll that conceals you from ordinary sight for a limited time. True-sighted enemies may still detect you.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Fireball
merchantStock.description: Aim within 6 visible tiles. A 5×5 blast without corners deals 10–50 damage per creature, including you, ignoring armor. Walls block fire. Preview then Cast; Cancel costs nothing.

merchantStock.name: Flint Stone
merchantStock.description: Reusable fire-lighting tool. Use an abandoned campfire to light it with brushwood.

merchantStock.name: Brushwood
merchantStock.description: Dry fuel for an abandoned campfire. One bundle burns for 12 turns. Carry up to five.

merchantStock.name: Arrows
merchantStock.description: Ammunition for bows. Each shot consumes one arrow.
